mapper.insert: INSERT INTO license_audit_log (operator, operator_ip, old_license_id, new_license_id, action, result, error_msg, created_at) VALUES (#{operator}, #{operatorIp}, #{oldLicenseId}, #{newLicenseId}, #{action}, #{result}, #{errorMsg}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, operator, operator_ip, old_license_id, new_license_id, action, result, error_msg, created_at FROM license_audit_log ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
